reviewNotes: Five branches compare the saved six-piece endings with White Kf3 at 108s and Ke2 at 87s. Kf3 wins; Ke2 draws. In the independently reconstructed winning race Kg4/Kxa5, Kxh3 is the only winning capture; Kxg5 first draws. The correct continuation Kxh3/Kb5/Kg4/Kc5/Kxg5 preserves the win. Earlier eight-piece Nd4/Kf3 zugzwang and uniqueness claims remain source context. Source king-race animation skips moves, so all encoded race continuations are explicitly independent legal representatives.
